parsed.rationale: Both members are unnamed extensions on `UserDefaults` living in the same `Caching` package. Having two separate extension sites for the same type within one package creates a name-collision risk and makes it harder to reason about the full surface area of the extension. Consolidating both extension bodies into a single file — most naturally `UserDefaults+WXYC.swift`, which is already dedicated to that purpose — eliminates the collision and centralises all `UserDefaults` augmentation in one place. Neither record carries any test, codegen, mock, or sample-app flag, so there is no intentional-duplication rationale to preserve the split.
